description: This PHP script renders a subpanel view for displaying and managing users associated with a role in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform. It sets up the UI components, including a form with hidden inputs, and initializes a ListView with a specific template to display user data in the context of roles.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, initialized with templates and data to display tabular lists.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes a new template for the list view with the specified HTML template and language strings.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the template for rendering, such as role record ID and image URLs.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title displayed on the list view.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Configures the query for filtering the list view data.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets custom header HTML or text for the list view.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view using the provided data and layout.
